Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001200": As of 2026-04-14, Farah is the primary on-call for the Dune team, having taken over from Tomasz.  (about: Tomasz, Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000551": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000547": On 2025-07-30, Tomasz left the Atlas team and joined the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1001211": As of 2026-04-14, Farah is the release captain for Q3 2025.  (about: Farah)
- memory_id "1001000": On 2026-02-11, Oskar wrote the feature-flags handover doc for Farah.  (about: feature-flags, Farah, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000476": On 2025-06-25, Oskar walked Farah through the job scheduler runbook as part of the handover.  (about: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000097": As of 2025-01-13, the first on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000048": As of 2025-01-09, Farah runs the Dune team solo until the next hire lands.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1001207": On 2026-04-14, the Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.  (about: Dune team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000703": As of 2025-09-23, the Dune team noticed that the bus's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Dune team, the bus)
- memory_id "1001071" [decision]: On 2026-02-11, the Ember team handed the feature-flags service to the Atlas team, not the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, Dune team, Ember team)
- memory_id "1001018": On 2026-02-16, the Dune team noticed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.  (about: Dune team, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000665": As of 2025-09-23, the job scheduler lives with the Cinder team, having moved from the Dune team.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000541": As of 2025-07-24, the Dune team sits on the fourth floor.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000338" [decision]: As of 2025-04-21, the Dune team adopted a monthly game day.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1001054": The Dune team never owned feature-flags; the 2026-02-11 feature-flags handover note was written against the wrong team.  (about: feature-flags, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000661": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000924": As of 2025-12-29, the Dune team observed that after the client rollout, the bus's request volume halved.  (about: Dune team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000601": As of 2025-08-19, the Dune team observed that after the runtime upgrade, the resizer's cold start time tripled.  (about: Dune team, the resizer)
- memory_id "1000869": The reporting service is an Ember team service, having previously been a Dune team service.  (about: Dune team, Ember team, reporting service)
